branchState.note: Android Native API 6 main delta reconciled by merge commit d0660fa1f9c562e826c5f8e81707f837368075cf. Later planning/test commits may increase ahead-by; the invariant is mainAncestor=true and behindBy=0.

cache.staticAssets: service-worker cache-first inside release-scoped cache namespace
cache.updateStrategy: new release token creates a new cache namespace; HTML/version probes remain network-authoritative
cache.missingStatic: must return HTTP 404 and never SPA HTML

content.persistentScope: release-scoped sessionStorage for Services and Masters; Community remains server-authoritative memory cache
content.routeRevisit: show cached content first; do not replace usable content with skeletons
content.refresh: TTL, connectivity recovery, WebView/app resume, and relevant realtime events
content.domUpdate: repaint only when the content signature changes
